shortDefinition.en: A camera whose reflex viewing path uses the taking lens and a mirror.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 通过拍摄镜头与反光镜进行反光取景的相机。

en: SLR can be film or digital; the D in DSLR specifies digital recording.
zh-cn: 单反可以是胶片或数码，DSLR 中的 D 才表示数码。

example.en: Canon FX is a film SLR.

en: In the conventional design, a mirror directs taking-lens light to a focusing screen during viewing and moves clear for exposure. The name identifies the viewing architecture, not the recording medium, format or professional status.
zh-cn: 常见结构在取景时用反光镜把拍摄镜头中的光导向对焦屏，曝光时让它离开光路。名称描述取景结构，不指定记录介质、画幅或专业等级。

sources.title: Canon Camera Museum — FX
sources.supports: A 35 mm film single-lens reflex camera; SLR does not imply digital.
